summary_en: This study tests dostarlimab, a drug given by IV, in people with stage II or III colon cancer that has deficient mismatch repair (dMMR). It is a Phase II, single-arm study, so all participants receive the same treatment. Dostarlimab is given as 500 mg IV every 3 weeks for 6 cycles, then 1000 mg every 6 weeks for 8 cycles, until 1.5 years. The study measures the rate of major clinical response and non-operative management after 18 weeks (up to 6 cycles).
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa dostarlimab, un medicamento que se administra por vía intravenosa, en personas con cáncer de colon en estadio II o III que tiene deficiencia en la reparación de errores de apareamiento (dMMR). Es un estudio de fase II de un solo brazo, por lo que todos los participantes reciben el mismo tratamiento. Dostarlimab se administra a 500 mg por vía IV cada 3 semanas durante 6 ciclos, y luego a 1000 mg cada 6 semanas durante 8 ciclos, hasta 1.5 años. El estudio mide la tasa de respuesta clínica mayor y de manejo no quirúrgico después de 18 semanas (hasta 6 ciclos).
who_for: Biopsy-proven dMMR colon cancer, stage II or III.
Potentially surgically resectable, and willing to forgo surgery if study endpoints are met.
ECOG performance status less than or equal to 1.
No metastatic disease on CT scan within 28 days of treatment start.
not_for: More than one primary tumor (synchronous primary tumor).
Obstruction or perforation needing a diverting ostomy or immediate resection.
Known hypersensitivity to dostarlimab or its components or excipients.
Grade 3 or higher immune-related adverse event with prior immunotherapy.
